description:
Watch videos together, perfectly in sync, no matter where your friends and family are. 

SyncTogether is a modern, low-latency shared media player crafted specifically for macOS. Whether you're streaming YouTube videos or watching local movies from your Mac, SyncTogether keeps everyone's playback in millisecond-accurate lockstep. When someone plays, pauses, or seeks, everyone stays synchronized automatically.

KEY FEATURES:

• STRICT LOCKSTEP PLAYBACK
Millisecond-accurate synchronization engine with automatic drift correction and readiness gating. Play, pause, scrub, and seek together without getting out of sync. Late joiners are instantly synced to the host's current position.

• TWO VERSATILE PLAYBACK MODES
- YouTube Integration: Paste any public YouTube link or playlist to start watching together immediately.
- Local Video Files: Watch MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, and other video files on your drive with hardware-accelerated playback. Built-in hash verification ensures everyone is watching the exact same file.

• LIVE VOICECAMS & FACECAMS
Bring your watch party to life! Multi-participant live audio and video tiles let you see and hear your friends' real-time reactions right alongside the video without leaving the app.

• REAL-TIME CHAT & ANIMATED REACTIONS
Engage during the stream with built-in instant messaging, live typing indicators, and expressive animated emoji reactions that float across the screen.

• INSTANT ROOMS & INVITE LINKS
Create private watch party rooms in seconds. Share a simple 6-character room code or send an invite link (synctogether://join/code) for one-click joining.

• PRIVACY-FIRST & SECURE
No tracking, no invasive ads, and no selling of your personal data. Join instantly as an anonymous guest with one click, or sign in securely with Apple ID, Google, or Email OTP.

• NATIVE MACOS EXPERIENCE
Tailored for macOS with keyboard shortcuts, picture-in-picture, full-screen theater mode, and a distraction-free dark cinema aesthetic.

Start your next movie night or video watch party today with SyncTogether!

SYNCTOGETHER PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly, that unlocks up to 16 watchers per room, up to 20 active rooms, persistent rooms, video facecams, watch sessions up to 24 hours and extended animated reactions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://synctogether.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://synctogether.app/privacy

promotionalText: Watch videos together in real-time sync with friends! Stream YouTube or local files with low-latency voice, live facecams, and instant chat.
whatsNew:
• NEW DOCKED THEATER LAYOUT
A cleaner cinema room: a title bar across the top, the picture with its controls beneath, and chat in its own column beside it. Nothing floats over the video, and it adapts at every window size.

• SAFER ROOMS
New moderation tools and clearer warnings help keep rooms friendly.

• CHAT & SUBTITLE FIXES
Chat no longer shows an error box when the window layout changes, half-typed messages survive resizing, and subtitles rise out from behind floating controls.

• FASTER ROOM EXIT
Leaving or ending a room no longer freezes for a few seconds.

• RELIABILITY
Smoother sign-in, friendlier messages for unsupported audio formats, steadier uploads, and better handling of flaky connections.
